name: Auckland
industries: Nation-scale infrastructure programmes, health technology exporters and the Wynyard Quarter tech scene drive demand.
intro:
Auckland carries New Zealand's growth load: a third of the country lives here, the City Rail Link and housing programmes are the nation's largest-ever construction efforts, and the tech exporters clustered around Wynyard Quarter compete globally from a small home base. Certified project professionals are scarce enough that credentials genuinely move salaries, and both PMP and Scrum certifications are instantly understood. Batches are scheduled live online across the whole year at hours built for Auckland: a weekend Sat–Sun cohort and a weekday Wed–Thu cohort each week, all landing in comfortable local daytime; every upcoming date and its exact Auckland timing is listed in the schedule below. The format never changes: live weekend instruction, exam application support, realistic mocks, and trainer access until you're certified.

Auckland carries most of New Zealand's corporate project load: the banks and insurers run trans-Tasman change portfolios, the utilities and transport agencies manage infrastructure programs, and the local product-tech scene adds agile delivery demand. In a market this size, certification travels fast — the credentialed pool is small enough that it genuinely re-sorts shortlists. The course runs live online across two consecutive days shown in Auckland local time on this page — no Harbour Bridge crossing for a classroom. New Zealand compensation for certified project professionals is strongest in Auckland; the sourced entries in the salary table below give dated, named local figures. The employer list reflects the banking-utilities-tech mix, and trans-Tasman organizations can certify teams on both sides through one private cohort.

faq.q: What are the class timings in Auckland?
faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM AET, which is 11:00 AM – 08:00 PM GMT+12 in Auckland. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.q: Is the training online or at a venue in Auckland?
faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Auckland. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from New Zealand?
faq.a: No. The certification is issued by the same global body regardless of where you attend from, and holds identical recognition with employers in New Zealand and internationally.

faq.q: Can my employer in Auckland sponsor the course?
faq.a: Yes. We issue invoices suitable for corporate sponsorship and reimbursement, and most employers in New Zealand accept them under learning and development budgets. Group pricing is available for teams.

faq.q: How much does {course} training cost in Auckland?
faq.a: The fee for the live online {course} course for Auckland is shown at the top of this page in NZD and covers the complete two-day program. No extra charges appear at checkout — the displayed fee is the whole training cost.

faq.q: Should I pick the weekday or weekend {course} batch in Auckland?
faq.a: They are the same {course} course on different days. If your Auckland role has hard weekday commitments, take Sat–Sun; otherwise Wed–Thu gets you certified mid-week. Check the table above for Auckland local times.

faq.q: Can I take the {course} exam from Auckland?
faq.a: Yes — the {course} exam can be taken online from Auckland; you do not need to travel. The exam and certification guide further up this page explains the exact format, attempts and booking process.

faq.q: Is {course} certification recognized by employers in Auckland?
faq.a: Yes. The {course} credential is issued by its global certifying body and is the one most commonly named in relevant Auckland job descriptions. The employer list on this page shows where certified professionals in Auckland work.

faq.q: What salary can a {course}-certified professional expect in Auckland?
faq.a: See the salary table on this page — every Auckland figure carries a named source and an as-of date, so you can verify it rather than trust a marketing average. Certified professionals typically use these sourced numbers in appraisal and offer negotiations.

faq.q: How soon can I start {course} training in Auckland?
faq.a: The batch table above lists the next start dates for Auckland — two cohorts run every week (weekday and weekend), so you are never more than a few days from a {course} start.

faq.q: Do you offer group pricing for {course} training for teams in Auckland?
faq.a: Yes. Teams in Auckland can enroll together under group pricing, and larger groups can run a private {course} cohort scheduled to their own calendar — use the enquiry option on this page with your team size.

faq.q: What language is the {course} training in Auckland delivered in?
faq.a: All live {course} sessions are delivered in English, the working language of certification exams and of most project teams in Auckland. Trainers take questions throughout the live sessions.

faq.q: How do I enroll in the {course} course from Auckland?
faq.a: Pick a batch from the table above and use its Enroll button — you'll get a confirmation by email. The full flow is online; nothing requires visiting an office in Auckland.

faq.q: Where can I see the {course} exam fee for New Zealand?
faq.a: The exam-cost section on this page lists the current {course} exam fee for New Zealand with a link to the certifying body's official fee page, so the number you plan around is the official one.

faq.q: Why choose live online {course} training over a self-paced course in Auckland?
faq.a: A recorded course leaves you alone with the material. Live {course} training gets Auckland professionals trainer feedback on real scenarios and a fixed two-day finish line.
